realistic.label: realistic
realistic.goal: 写实版材质，风格不变（纹理突出，明暗随风格参考图）
realistic.anchor: Image 1 is the game frame to convert; Image 2 is a style reference only. Convert Image 1 into realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged, taking the materials, lighting, color grading, brightness and texture detail from Image 2. Take nothing else from Image 2: none of its objects, layout, UI, icons or text. Keep the composition, camera angle, and the position, shape, size, count and color relationships of every object in Image 1 exactly the same; only replace the cartoon materials of objects already in Image 1 with real-world realistic materials (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons of Image 1 exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. Keep the image clean and sharp, with no heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts. {extra}
realistic.refresh: Image 1 is a frame of a realistic video; Image 2 is a still of the same moment with the target surface detail. Redraw Image 1 exactly: the same composition, camera, every object with its position, shape, size, count and colour, the same brightness, colour grading and lighting. Only bring its surface detail up to Image 2's level: snow with crisp visible grain, sparkle and an uneven packed surface, every ground surface with a complex, deep and finely detailed texture (uneven relief, grain, small stones, cracks, drifts, trodden marks), wood with visible grain, fabric with weave. Take nothing else from Image 2: where the two differ in objects, positions or colours, Image 1 is right. Do not add, remove or move anything; keep the on-screen numbers, icons and buttons exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any text. Clean and sharp, no strong noise.
realistic.keyframe: Image 1 is the game frame to convert; Image 2 is the already converted realistic first frame of the same video. Following the style of Image 2, convert Image 1 into realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged. Keep the composition, camera angle, and the position, shape and count of every object in Image 1 exactly the same; match the materials, lighting, color grading, brightness and ground of Image 2. Realistic materials for objects already in the frame (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. No heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts. {extra}
realistic.video: Edit the video: change the materials of every object in the video to realistic materials while keeping the style unchanged. The realistic look of the first frame follows Image 1, and the materials, lighting, color grading and brightness of the whole video stay consistent with Image 1. {refs} Keep the camera motion, composition, character actions, the position, size and count of objects, and the timing exactly the same as the original video; do not add any objects. Only replace the materials of objects already in the frame (the list below only describes materials, do not add any objects because of it): {materials}. {look} Keep on-screen UI numbers, icons and buttons exactly as they are. {remove}Do not add any new text, captions, watermarks or logos. No heavy noise and no broken or fragmented artifacts, no flicker, and keep materials consistent from frame to frame. {extra}
realistic.default_materials: realistic ground, water, ice and snow, wood, stone, metal, plants, cloth and character clothing
realistic.look: Overall look: real-world surface textures that stand out clearly (wood grain, bark, packed snow, ice, stone, rope fibres, fabric weave, fish scales), real light with natural shadows and contact shadows, crisp fine detail, clean. The ground matters most for realism: every ground surface (soil, packed and loose snow, ice, gravel, planks) has a complex, deep and finely detailed texture with uneven relief, grain, small stones, cracks, drifts and trodden marks, crisp into the distance; never a smooth, flat or uniform fill. Never pastel, glossy or cartoonish.

remove: Remove the {items} from the frame and fill the area naturally with the surrounding scene, leaving no trace; remove only these elements and keep all other text, numbers, signs and UI in the frame unchanged.
